name: Souvenir
description: Inhabits optical augments and occasionally overlays images from other places — a beach viewed through a Shelf corridor, a forest superimposed on a warehouse. Brief. Beautiful. Inexplicable.
observed_behavior: Projects location-tagged image data from the EDN network onto the user's visual feed. The images are from real places, captured by real sensors, transmitted without request.
story_hooks: A Shelf resident who has never left Meridian sees the ocean — the real ocean, not the harbor. Through their own eyes. For three seconds.
